newsitem.title: USA: Hurricane Hortense strengthens to 90 mph.
newsitem.headline: Hurricane Hortense strengthens to 90 mph.

text.p: Hurricane Hortense strengthened early Wednesday, packing winds of 90 mph (145 kmh) as it moved northwest through the Caribbean, the National Hurricane Center said.
At 8 a.m. EDT, Hortense was located 60 miles (95 kmh) east-southeast of the Turks and Caicos, at latitude 21.1 north and longitude 70.3 west.
The storm was moving northwest at 13 mph (20 kmh).
Forecasters at the hurricane center said Hortense was likely to strengthen even more during the next day or two.
A hurricane warning remained in effect for the north coast of the Dominican Republic stretching to the border of Haiti. A warning was also in effect for the Turks and Caicos and the southern Bahamas.
A hurricane watch was in effect for the central Bahamas.
